_notes: Every key this app reads. name, line, avatar, url, and links are needed; socials, vcard, and theme are optional. avatar is a picture file in this folder. url is the address the page will live at; the QR code opens it. A link takes label, url (https://, http://, mailto:, or tel:), and an optional icon: link, shop, calendar, mail, letter, play, music, mic, camera, book, heart, star, pin, chat, code, gift, or globe. socials takes handles or full addresses for instagram, tiktok, youtube, x, threads, bluesky, mastodon (user@server), github, linkedin, pinterest, twitch, dribbble, facebook, spotify (full address), and website (full address). vcard fills the Save contact card. theme is dawn, dusk, mono, or candy.
